verdict.rationale: Plaid Link is documented as the drop-in client-side component users interact with to link their accounts, with Dashboard-based flow customization (plaid-docs-5, plaid-docs-11). Community reports independently confirm Plaid supplies the institution-search and login UI inside integrating apps (plaid-comm-9, plaid-comm-10). A public_token tied to the linked Item is referenced via the Sandbox endpoint (plaid-docs-14). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of server-side session (link_token) creation, documentation of the public_token returned from Link in production and its exchange for an access token.
